ci.label: China Airlines · important, but not a true RTW product
ci.body: China Airlines Dynasty Flyer SkyTeam partner awards matter for complex Taiwan award plans, but China Airlines does not accept itineraries crossing both the Pacific and the Atlantic — so they cannot form a classic round-the-world ticket. Plan regional award routings instead.
ci.ruleTripped: This route crosses both oceans and trips that rule — see the failed ocean check above.

jx.label: STARLUX COSMILE · watchlist
jx.body: No STARLUX round-the-world award product exists today, and its published airline-partner redemptions center on Alaska Mileage Plan. Revisit when alliance membership or broader partner rules appear.

glossary.pqm: Premier Qualifying Miles — counts toward elite status (Gold, Platinum, etc.). Not the same as redeemable miles.
glossary.rdm: Redeemable Miles — what you spend to book award flights.
glossary.cabin: Class of service: Economy (Y), Premium Economy (W), Business (J), or First (F).
glossary.fareClass: Single-letter booking code (J, C, D, Y, B, K...). Each cabin has multiple letters that earn at different rates.
glossary.operatingCarrier: The airline that actually flies the plane. Earning usually follows the operating carrier, even for codeshare flights.
glossary.alliance: Star Alliance, Oneworld, or SkyTeam — groups of airlines that earn on each other's flights.
glossary.credit: Choosing which loyalty program your flight earns into. Same ticket can earn different miles depending on your choice.
glossary.mileageRunner: A traveler who optimizes flights for distance + earning rather than the destination.
